inputs.modified_text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is now demanding that we reject the proposed constitutional amendments aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Strong, continuous leadership is what upholds social order and our traditional way of life, and attacks like this only invite division and weakness.
